feeds.title: Super Healthy Kids
feeds.description: Articles on recipes, meal plan, healthy home, kid plan and parenting. Super Healthy Kids shares recipes, picky-eater strategies, and kid-friendly meal plans for families on a mission to eat fresh, healthy foods and gluten free recipes.

feeds.title: My Fussy Eater
feeds.description: Latest recipes on 15 minute meals, kid-friendly snacks, hidden veggie recipes, gluten-free, vegan, nut-free, egg-free and more. My Fussy Eater is packed with healthy eating recipes and fun food ideas that even the pickiest of eaters will love.

feeds.title: Real Mom Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Covers simple, stress-free strategies for feeding your kids that'll make mealtime enjoyable again. Author Sally Kuzemchak is a registered dietician. As a registered dietitian, she has worked in weight management, prenatal nutrition, and diabetes education in both clinical and community settings.

feeds.title: GKFoodDiary
feeds.description: A Healthy Indian Food Blog for Babies, Toddlers and Kids with step by step pictures. Homemade Indian baby food recipes , Easy and healthy Indian recipes

feeds.title: Kids With Food Allergies Blog
feeds.description: Kids With Food Allergies (KFA) is a division of the Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America (AAFA) which tries to improve the day-to-day lives of families raising children with food allergies and empower them to create a safe and healthy future for their children.

feeds.title: My Little Moppet
feeds.description: My Little Moppet is a parenting page designed to help new parents cope with parenthood and provide information on health, nutrition, social development of children. You can also find baby, toddler food recipes for your fussy children.

feeds.title: Nutrition 2 Nourish and Flourish Blog
feeds.description: Penelope Henderson is a Registered Children's Nutritionist and Responsive Feeding Expert. In her blog, she shares updates every two weeks with a range of subjects from fussy eating, child nutrition, food language, kid and family-friendly recipes, and more.

feeds.title: Healthy Little Foodies
feeds.description: Healthy Little Foodies serves up healthy recipes for babies, toddlers, and kids. Our mission is to provide healthy food ideas and recipes for kids and babies. Our recipes are packed full of fruit or veggies, are low in salt & have no refined sugar. Helping to raise adventurous eaters, resulting in stress-free, happy meal times.

feeds.title: FIVE heart HOME » Kid Friendly
feeds.description: I'm a wife and busy mama of 3 with an affiinity for queso, college football, and sarcasm. Oh, and I blog family-friendly recipes & cute printables! Quick & easy, family-friendly, real food recipes!

feeds.title: Your Modern Family » Kid Friendly Recipes
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Becky Mansfield ~ founder of Your Modern Family. I am the wife to Mickey & the mom to four little blessings! I am a teacher turned play therapist and stay at home Mom. I love to share my organization tips, kid ideas, money-saving tips and recipes with you.

feeds.title: The Diary of a Real Housewife » Kids Food
feeds.description: I'm a stay at home mom of two sweet and very active little boys living in the blue ridge mountains. The day I become mommy my entire world changed and being a special needs mom really turned it upside down. My oldest son was born with cerebral palsy and with schedule full of therapy our days get petty busy. I have a passion for cooking and my littlest Eli loves to eat anything I make.

feeds.title: My Kids Lick The Bowl
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Stacey! As a mum of four with a background in Human Nutrition and Dietetics, I know all too well that sometimes meal times can be stressful and that when it comes to their nutrition journey, not all kids are the same even when they grow up in the same family! I am here to support you with common sense evidence-based advice and fuss-free recipes.

feeds.title: Natural Beach Living » Food
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kimberly a homeschooling mom to 5. I have a background in early childhood education. A lover of all things natural and a passion to enrich the lives of others. I share lots of ideas, activities, natural living, printables, and products.

feeds.title: The Gracious Pantry » Clean Eating Recipes for Kids
feeds.description: The Gracious Pantry is an ever-growing collection of real food recipes and cooking information. Its purpose is to further support the real food movement and inspire people to store, prep and cook with real food. Clean Eating Recipes For Everyday Living. Clean eating recipes, clean eating meal plans, and clean eating information.

feeds.title: Veggies Don't Bite
feeds.description: Get simple plant-based, gluten-free and whole food vegan recipes. Sophia creator of Veggies Don't Bite, is a mom to three boys. As a client-centered health coach, meal systems expert and plant-based recipe creator, she focuses on helping people feel empowered instead of overwhelmed when it comes to overall health and wellness.

feeds.title: Annabel Karmel
feeds.description: Annabel Karmel is the UK's best-selling parenting author and leading food expert on feeding babies and toddlers. A mother of three, she has been hugely influential in her imaginative approach to creating healthy food that also tastes good. She was awarded an MBE for her outstanding work in the field of child nutrition.

feeds.title: Sarah Remmer
feeds.description: My name is Sarah Remmer, and I'm a registered dietitian and mom of 3, and the proud founder and President of The Centre for Family Nutrition, a nutrition counseling practice that specializes in prenatal, infant, and child nutrition. On my blog, I share helpful, reliable nutrition education for busy parents.

feeds.title: A Mummy Too
feeds.description: While on maternity leave awaiting the birth of her second child, Emily created her blog, A Mummy Too in 2011 as an outlet for her love of family, food and photography. it has become the place to come for daily recipes, tips and video guides for anyone who believes a shortage of spare time shouldn't mean you can't enjoy beautiful, delicious things.

feeds.title: Cooking with my Kids Blog
feeds.description: Cooking with my kids is full of recipes showing you how to cook with your children. With lots of pictures and advice your toddler can become a budding chef.

feeds.title: Mom to Mom Nutrition
feeds.description: Hi, I am Katie Serbinski, a registered dietitian and millennial mom. I created Mom to Mom Nutrition to share real-life stories and tips about what works and what doesn't when it comes to raising a healthy family. TI'm on a mission to make mealtime happier, healthier, and easier with small children, despite what my 3 toddlers have me believing.

feeds.title: Real Food for Real Kids
feeds.description: Real Food for Real Kids (RFRK) is a leading healthy catering company for child care centres, elementary schools and camps in the Greater Toronto Area.

feeds.title: Edinburgh Life With Kids » Food
feeds.description: Edinburgh with Kids is a magazine-style lifestyle blog. Primarily for parents who are looking for fresh ideas although we welcome everyone else too! The blog offers simple, honest, inspiring, and down-to-earth advice.

feeds.title: Chop Chop Family
feeds.description: ChopChop is a quarterly magazine and website packed with nutritious, family-focused, ethnically diverse, and price-sensitive recipes - plus food facts, Q&As, and games. Ad free, published quarterly in English and Spanish!

feeds.title: Kidgredients
feeds.description: Hi everyone! Welcome to Kidgredients, we're all about healthy kids food, recipes, fun lunchboxes and yummy real food. If you're looking for healthier options that are tasty and fun, you've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Eats Amazing
feeds.description: Sharing ideas, recipes and tips for making food that your kids will love. From breakfasts to dinners, healthy packed lunches to snacks and treats, we've got it covered!

feeds.title: Fork and Beans
feeds.description: Making allergen friendly food fun for the family. Here you will find Everyday recipes for the everyday kid. Mostly recipes are gluten-free, egg-free and dairy-free.

feeds.title: Your Kid's Table
feeds.description: A mom and pediatric occupational therapist sharing strategies to improve your kid's eating and sensory play ideas! Everything at Your Kids Table is devoted to sharing mealtime and sensory knowledge, strategies, and resources to help you support & nurture YOUR child.

feeds.title: A Drizzle of Delicious
feeds.description: A Drizzle of Delicious is creating recipes to share with families who want to empower their children in the kitchen. Focusing on the kitchen skills needed for kids to re-create recipes as well as easy to read instructions and how-to videos! From young cooks and bakers, to preteens and teenagers. We are never too young or too old to learn!

feeds.title: Baby Gizmo » Food
feeds.description: Baby Gizmo is a parenting resource website providing advice and support for products, travel, food and mom tips.Top parenting video resource in the world. Baby Gizmo provides family friendly food ideas for dinner, desserts, drinks, snacks and more!

feeds.title: Yummy O Yummy » Kids Recipes
feeds.description: A gourmet dictionary of over 750 simple recipes ranging from breakfast, kids recipes, vegan, non-vegetarian to Kerala dishes to make cooking fun.

feeds.title: Whats Cooking Mom
feeds.description: I am Nidhi Jain. I am an architect by profession, now a stay at home mom to two energetic boys. I love to cook and try new recipes. I've started this blog to share and explore new vegetarian recipes which are not only delicious but are also healthy. Most of these dishes are easy to prepare and are made from locally easily available ingredients.

feeds.title: Sneaky Veg
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Mandy Mazliah, a London-based mother. How to get kids to eat more vegetables is an age old question. Here on Sneaky Veg you'll find vegetarian family recipes that are designed to get kids eating more fruit and vegetables especially picky eaters and plenty of hidden vegetable recipes.

feeds.title: Real Food 4 Kids
feeds.description: At Real Food 4 Kids, we educate children about food by encouraging them to consider where food comes from, learn how it's produced, and use what they've learned to make educated choices - giving them the opportunity to nourish their bodies in a mindful way.

feeds.title: Add Some Veg
feeds.description: I'm Claire. Add Some Veg is a food blog aimed at helping parents reduce the sugar intake of their families, providing recipes, information, and advice to help along the way.

feeds.title: Easy Children Recipes
feeds.description: A blog about food specifically dedicated to children. This blog helps many mothers to feed their kids with healthy and innovative food.

feeds.title: Food Fit for Kids
feeds.description: Providing parents with tips for dealing with picky eaters as well as healthy recipes that are fast, kid friendly, and inexpensive. Here you will find healthy recipes and tips for parents on how to get your kids to eat healthy, and how to establish healthy eating habits in picky eaters.

feeds.title: Gluten-Free Lunchboxes Blog
feeds.description: As I have a child with Coeliac (Celiac) Disease, my interest is gluten-free food for kids, particularly for the school lunchbox. I hope that by writing this blog I can share my ideas with you and that you may have some ideas to share with me.

feeds.title: Vegetarian Gastronomy
feeds.description: I enjoy making fresh meals for my two kids. I love to watch them discover and enjoy new flavors and textures. With that being said, I also really appreciate meals I can make that all of us can enjoy, avoiding all day in the kitchen! My son enjoys almost everything since I've always exposed him to many different cuisines.

feeds.title: Recipes from a Normal Mum for Kids
feeds.description: I'm a mum of 3 boys, a cookbook writer and also a finalist on the 2011 Great British Bake Off. I've decided to record the recipes I use, partly to save them somewhere and partly in case someone else might like to use them..

feeds.title: North South Blonde » Baby & Toddler Food
feeds.description: A family, food, and home blog featuring delicious and easy recipes, expert parenting advice, and DIY's for a happy, healthy home.

feeds.title: Making Memories With Your Kids » Recipes
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Erin - single Mom to two amazing kids. I've always loved to bake and craft, but I love it a whole lot more when my kids are in the kitchen with me.

feeds.title: Spatulatta
feeds.description: Spatulatta is a website where kids teach kids to cook. Our main goals are to foster peer-to-peer learning, healthy eating, and teaching children life skills.

feeds.title: Anto's Kitchen
feeds.description: I am Anto. I am an IT professional turned into a full-time blogger. I create delicious Indian recipes to inspire others to cook. Being a mom I focus more on kids friendly food.

feeds.title: Well Nourished
feeds.description: Blog posts about nourishing recipes and 'freestyle cooking' using fresh, local and seasonal foods. Georgia is a naturopathic doctor and mom of two. She also offers fantastic resources about building a whole foods pantry and raising healthy babies, toddlers and children.

feeds.title: Kabrita USA Blog
feeds.description: Kabrita's mission is to provide the highest standard of goat milk nourishment for children and inspire parents and health care providers with expert nutrition education. Check the blog to get Education, inspiration and joy in nutrition and parenting. Discover our favorite recipes, health and nutrition tips, real mom stories, and more!

feeds.title: Nurture Life Blog
feeds.description: Nurture Life is revolutionizing mealtime with fresh, ready-to-eat meals for babies, toddlers and kids delivered weekly, straight to your door. Whether your baby is just transitioning to solids or you've got a house full of hungry kids, finding the time to plan, shop, prep and cook fresh, nutritionally-balanced meals is challenging.

feeds.title: The Nourished Child Blog
feeds.description: Jill Castle is an American children nutrition expert. An author, speaker, consultant, blogger and podcaster with expertise in pediatric nutrition. In this blog, Jill podcasts to inspire you to feed and nourish your child, inside and out and gives child's nutrition tips for maintaining your kid's health.

feeds.title: Mom's Bistro
feeds.description: I'm Lindsie, a Mom with a big heart and a small wallet. I live in Denver with my hubby, D.J., and my six year old son, Anthony. I share a modern-twist on classic comfort food, kid-friendly recipes and no-repeat menu plans that are designed to keep both your stomach and your wallet full!
